decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 20 September 2006, the erection of a single storey side and rear extensions and roof extension as shown on drawing number 0618/TP.01, 0618/TP.02, 0618/TP.05,  received 20 September 2006 and 0618/TP.03 (Rev B), 0618/TP.04 (Rev C), received 14 November 2006 is less than 15% of the entire gross floor area of the existing dwelling, measuring 106.7m3 was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The development falls within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Classes A, B and C of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 because the proposed extension is under 115 cubic metres and is within 15% of the original dwelling house.
Condition : 2 - The proposed roof extension must not be higher than any part of the existing ridge of the roof. The original ridgeline and ridge capping of the house should be maintained.
Condition : 3 - The roof lights hereby permitted shall be flush with the existing plane of the roof.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of single storey rear and side extension  and erection of roof extension to house
